raw_segments.text: Autolycus, lawn as white as driven snow, cypress black as air was crow, gloves as sweet as
damask roses, masks for faces and for noses, bugle bracelet, necklace amber, perfume for
a lady's chamber, golden coifs and stomachers for my lads to give their deers, pins and
poking sticks of steel, what maids lack from head to heel.
Come by of me, come, come by, come by, buy, lads or else your lasses cry.
